description: This is a React custom hook module that logs, during development, a verification of the API endpoint URL `/api/users` to ensure it resolves correctly to include an organization ID parameter, using a function `quickUsersResolutionSmoke`. In production, it performs no network calls.

methods.name: useVerifyUsersUrlOnce()
methods.description: A React hook that logs the resolved URL of the `/api/users` endpoint during development for verification purposes, ensuring the API URL resolves correctly with the specified query parameter.
